sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Sector breadth is extremely narrow, with Technology standing as the sole all-green sector while defensive and energy groups dominate the upper momentum ranks.

Market leadership remains heavily concentrated, with only 1 of 11 sectors exhibiting positive performance across all timeframes. Technology (momentum 0.883) and Energy (momentum 0.783) continue to hold the highest ranks, while Healthcare is rapidly gaining ground. 

Rotation is tilting toward defensives as Healthcare climbs, contrasted by sharp deterioration in rate-sensitive and cyclical sectors. Utilities and Real Estate occupy the bottom of the momentum table, with Financials exhibiting early signs of fatigue.

## Strength
- **Narrow leadership:** Technology is the only all-green group across the week, month, quarter, half, and YTD, carrying the market's highest momentum score of 0.883 (rank 2).
- **Resilient frontrunners:** Energy retains the top overall spot (rank 1) with strong momentum at 0.783, followed closely by Basic Materials at rank 3 (momentum 0.633).
- **Improving core:** Healthcare gained +2 spots over the last five sessions, rising to rank 5 with solid momentum of 0.733.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Top gainers:** Healthcare paced short-term improvements (+2 spots, momentum 0.73), while Consumer Defensive advanced +1 spot to rank 7 (momentum 0.40).
- **Steepest decliners:** Real Estate suffered the sharpest five-day drop, falling -2 spots to rank 8 alongside a weak 0.183 momentum score.
- **Persistent laggards:** Utilities sits firmly at the bottom with a momentum score of 0.067 (rank 10), joined by Consumer Cyclical at rank 11 (momentum 0.217).

## Divergences
- **Fading momentum:** Financials triggered an early-warning signal, shedding -1 spot over five days to rank 6 despite holding an otherwise firm momentum score of 0.600.
- **Defensive divergence:** Consumer Defensive gained ground (+1 spot) despite lagging absolute momentum (0.400), reflecting a selective bid beneath the surface.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Narrow market breadth favors select healthcare, energy, and tech infrastructure leaders, while materials and energy-adjacent commodities face sharp short-term deterioration.

Pockets of healthcare are experiencing aggressive positive rotation, led by Diagnostics & Research and Health Information Services, both displaying high momentum alongside rapid rank gains. Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.993) and Marine Shipping (0.959) remain dominant across all timeframes.

Conversely, extractive materials and legacy commodities are fading quickly. Coking Coal, Thermal Coal, and Aluminum suffered steep 5-session drops, while broader breadth remains tight with only 9 of 144 industry groups maintaining all-green profiles.

## Strength
- **Sustained Leadership:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.993, rank YTD 2) and Marine Shipping (momentum 0.959, rank YTD 5) hold sustained top-36 positioning across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.
- **Narrow All-Green Core:** Only 9 of 144 industry groups are positive across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD periods, including Consumer Electronics (momentum 0.899), Copper (momentum 0.867), Insurance - Reinsurance (momentum 0.83), and Software - Infrastructure (momentum 0.77).
- **Defensive Durability:** Diagnostics & Research, Insurance - Life, and Health Information Services continue to demonstrate persistent multi-month rank strength.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Healthcare Surging:** Diagnostics & Research climbed +26 spots over 5 sessions to rank 45 (momentum 0.893), while Drug Manufacturers - Specialty & Generic jumped +16 spots to rank 81 (momentum 0.62).
- **Steepest Declines:** Coking Coal dropped -39 spots to rank 107 (momentum 0.26), Business Equipment & Supplies fell -27 spots to rank 69 (momentum 0.46), and Aluminum shed -24 spots to rank 97 (momentum 0.24).
- **Severe Momentum Laggards:** Mortgage Finance (0.043, rank YTD 142), Gambling (0.093, rank YTD 143), and Solar (0.093, rank YTD 135) sit firmly at the bottom of relative performance.

## Divergences
- **Fading Momentum:** Banks - Diversified (momentum 0.69) and Oil & Gas E&P (momentum 0.63) both slipped -4 spots over the past 5 sessions, joined by softening ranks in REIT - Healthcare Facilities (momentum 0.65, -3 spots) and Agricultural Inputs (momentum 0.65, -2 spots).
- **Emerging Upward Inflections:** Rank improvements are outpacing baseline momentum in Conglomerates (+10 spots, momentum 0.49), Education & Training Services (+9 spots, momentum 0.49), and Aerospace & Defense (+8 spots, momentum 0.43).
